about: Best formal result per question in the formalisation gap, with history.

entries.result: In our tagging: continuum 14, joint sharpness 9, smooth 4, labelled 3, distinguishability 2, local realism 1 (of 22).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No continuum information variable on a finite substrate
entries.result: A substrate with finitely many states has no family of non-empty pairwise-disjoint attributes indexed by R.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: Any real-valued quantity on a finite substrate misses every open interval: a finite-atom neck cannot sweep a continuum of radii.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: In the deterministic theory, sending x and y to disjoint outputs is impossible if x and y overlap.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: In the deterministic theory, disjoint x, y with inhabited outputs can be sent to disjoint outputs.
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: sigma_x sigma_z != sigma_z sigma_x over C (ConstructorTheory/QNumber.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No state is sharp for both sigma_x and sigma_z
entries.result: No non-zero vector in C^2 is an eigenvector of both sigma_x and sigma_z (ConstructorTheory/QNumber.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: In the deterministic theory every variable is an information variable: its cloning task is possible (ConstructorTheory/CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: No superinformation in the deterministic theory
entries.result: The deterministic (classical) theory has no superinformation medium; no-cloning and complementarity need non-classical constructors (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Changing a conserved quantity is impossible (toy principle VIII)
entries.result: In a toy thermodynamic theory whose constructors conserve U, x -> y and y -> x are both impossible when U differs (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.cls: Decreasing the monotone is impossible (toy law of impotence)
entries.result: In the toy thermodynamic theory, x -> y is impossible when the entropy-like monotone is strictly lower on y (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: A task can be possible while its transpose is impossible (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)

entries.result: On Bool, false -> true is possible and true -> false impossible in the toy thermodynamic theory (CTRestatement.lean).
entries.status: proved in Lean (kernel-checked; no human referee)
